schools.intro_zh: 曼哈顿音乐学院（MSM）是位于纽约市的音乐学院，核心培养领域涵盖古典音乐、爵士与音乐剧。学院授予 BM、MM、DMA，并设 PPD、PS 证书和 AD；教师包括活跃于纽约主要乐团、爵士舞台和百老汇的职业艺术家，学生来自数十个国家。

Test scores are due with the application by December 1, 2025, and will be considered during the Prescreen process.
All applicants who have completed their online application and passed prescreening, if applicable, must audition in order to be admitted to MSM.
Manhattan School of Music has no minimum English test score requirements in order to apply. DMA applicants are held to a higher standard of English proficiency.
The Duolingo English Test is the only exam accepted; TOEFL and IELTS are not accepted. There is no minimum score required to apply.

Scores of 120+ are likely exempt from additional English Language Proficiency requirements; scores of 115 may be exempt or assigned Summer English Study, and lower bands have progressively more conditional outcomes.
